title: THE HEART THAT REFUSES TO BEND

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"'If in spite of this you still do not listen to me but continue to be
hostile toward me, then in my anger I will be hostile toward you, and I
myself will punish you for your sins seven times over'"
- Lev 26:27-28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Again and again the same tragic pattern repeats through this chapter: "if
you still do not listen." Warning after warning, and still a refusal to
turn. The heart that will not bend keeps colliding with consequences it
could have avoided.

This repetition is itself a message. God did not give up after the first
warning, or the second, or the third. His patience is astonishing. He
keeps calling, keeps pursuing, keeps giving opportunity to return.

Dear friend, we should be sobered by the human capacity to keep resisting
God. It is possible to grow so hardened that repeated warnings simply
bounce off. The book of Proverbs warns of the person who, though often
rebuked, remains stiff-necked and is suddenly destroyed (Prov 29:1).

But we should be equally struck by the patience of God running through
this whole passage. Every escalation was preceded by an opportunity to
turn. Paul asks, do you show contempt for the riches of His kindness,
forbearance and patience, not realising that God's kindness is meant to
lead you to repentance (Rom 2:4)?

Here is the searching question this passage puts to us: what is it going
to take? Must God keep raising His voice, or will we listen now?

Do not presume on God's patience by treating it as permission. His
kindness is an open door, not an open-ended delay. Turn to Him today,
while His voice is still calling.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where have I been presuming on God's patience instead of responding?
2. Is my heart growing softer or harder over time?
3. What is God calling me to turn from today, before He must call louder?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, thank You for Your astonishing patience with me. Do not let me
harden my heart. Give me ears to listen now and a will to turn to You
today. Amen.
